description: ReturnZero (리턴제로) is a speech-AI company based in Seoul, South Korea, founded in 2018 and also known for the VITO call-transcription app and Callabo meeting notes. Its RTZR STT OpenAPI offers batch and streaming speech-to-text with in-house Sommers models for Korean and Japanese and a Korean fine-tuned Whisper model for other languages; prices are in KRW.
name: ReturnZero (RTZR)
